2609.02954.title: LexIssue: Benchmarking Legal Issue Identification in Chinese Civil Litigation
2609.02954.paper_summary: Identifying the issues disputed between litigating parties is a crucial component of real-world litigation. However, legal issues remain comparatively underexplored in legal AI research. In this work, we study the computational modelling of legal issue identification in litigation. We introduce a legally grounded hierarchical schema that represents legal issues through both free-form issue descriptions and structured legal categories, and formulate legal issue identification as two complementary tasks: legal issue generation and legal issue classification. Based on this formulation, we construct LexIssue, a benchmark containing 430 real-world Chinese civil litigation cases and 1,303 expert-annotated disputed legal issues. We further develop an issue-centric legal knowledge base spanning 27 causes of action and 441 candidate legal issue entries to support retrieval-augmented reasoning. Experimental results across a diverse set of models show that retrieval-augmented generation using the constructed legal issue knowledge base consistently improves performance in identifying disputed legal issues and their corresponding legal attributes.
2609.02954.paper_summary_zh: 識別訴訟當事人之間爭議的問題是現實世界訴訟中的一個關鍵組成部分。<lb/>然而，法律問題在法律 AI 研究中仍然相對未被充分探討。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們研究法律問題識別的計算建模。<lb/>我們引入了一個法律基礎的層次結構，通過自由形式的問題描述和結構化的法律類別來表示法律問題，並將法律問題識別公式化為兩個互補的任務：法律問題生成和法律問題分類。<lb/>基於這一公式，我們構建了 LexIssue，一個包含 430 個現實世界的中國民事訴訟案例和 1,303 個專家註釋的爭議法律問題的基準。<lb/>我們進一步開發了一個以問題為中心的法律知識庫，涵蓋 27 種訴因和 441 個候選法律問題條目，以支持檢索增強推理。<lb/>在多種模型的實驗結果表明，使用構建的法律問題知識庫進行檢索增強生成在識別爭議法律問題及其相應法律屬性方面持續提高了性能。
